items.title: Joseph "Fan" Bourgeau Interview, 1972-09-13
items.q: I was thinking of Big I Louie Robinson. He was a piano player. Robinson? I know a lot of piano players, but I forgot their name.

ctx.x: Yeah. You know. All of them... All of them hit them white keys. All piano players I know hit them white keys. You know. Play with the black keys. You know. You got to grow up on them, you know.

Well, there were some guys that played by the year that played all the black keys stuff, you know. Oh. With Birmingham and Black Pete. What about Sun Squawm? Big I Louie? I played with Big I Louie too.

Yeah. And that down there, he's playing with them. Where? Town of the Legends. Oh yeah. I was thinking of Big I Louie Robinson. He was a piano player. Robinson? I know a lot of piano players, but I forgot their name. Did you know Ed Mercier or...
